note: A `throw' out of a loaded file to a `catch' around the (load ...). Emacs evaluates the loaded file inside the dynamic extent of the call, so the catch receives 99. kg's loader contains the loaded text's completion so that an *error* can be resignalled into the enclosing run (the load-error-condition-reachability row, closed in the same slice this one was opened) -- and that containment barrier is a throw wall exactly as the protected call's is, so the throw finds no catch and becomes (no-catch load-tag 99). The condition-case around the catch is what makes both sides return a value rather than one of them aborting: Emacs never reaches it. Closing this needs `load' to be an fe primitive with a frame kind of its own, so that no barrier stands between the throw and the catch at all -- Shape B, rejected by scope in 11A Decision 5, with a doc/TODO.md item.
